column1: # Reference words: labels that make a number a business number, not personal data
# (order, invoice, receipt ...). One entry per line, `#` comments, blank lines ignored; format
# in pl/references.tsv. A trailing `*` lets the word take suffixes (`fattur*`: `fattura`,
# `fatture`), a trailing `.` matches with or without the dot (`prot`/`prot.`).
# The shared check accepts "nr"/"no" between the label and the number but not the Italian
# "n." or "numero", so the forms with them are listed as entries (`fattura n.`).
# Every entry is scoped to the rules check for now: the NER check's negative words are pinned
# to the built-in list (tests/detect/test_reference_packs.py, LAB-1788), so an Italian label
# does not drop an NER number yet.
